acceptance.basis: Unchanged engineering completeness/coverage/ATE/RPE limits from the previous plane study. Fixed before first image-tracking/PnP fitting; not publisher accuracy requirements or physical calibration guarantees.

calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

dense_fitting_preprocessing.depth_missing: any invalid tap makes filtered depth missing

dense_support_policy: Minimum count and a nonsingular system for initial/intermediate hypotheses; the unchanged 0.5 full-resolution correspondence fraction applies to the returned pose. The independent full-cloud support and complete trajectory accuracy gates are unchanged.
generation: All original adjacent frames with the previous returned source-to-target increment, starting identity. Native fitting uses owned float64 Gaussian3 gray/depth at full resolution before the unchanged pyramid. Final support/residuals use original raw images. No reference, rescale, retries, selection or lost-chain reset.
native_refinement_policy: Only the explicit full-resolution fitting input policy changes. No brightness normalization, derivative, update, stopping, downsample, numeric-control or final admission change. Charge both retained raw levels before allocating fit buffers.
scope: Prospective preprocessing block on two observed development scenes; preserve native causal and external comparator controls and all failures. Freeze both complete timelines before either reference score. No held-out, equivalence or speed claim. Canonical clock/physical calibration, raw Linux classes and full mapping/release remain open.
